ar.title: كسكسي تونسي باللحم والتمر
ar.intro: طبق تونسي تقليدي، كسكسي مع لحم غنم وتمر حلو.

steps.n1: قطّع اللحم إلى مكعبات صغيرة. اقشر الجزر واللفت وقطّعهما إلى مكعبات.
steps.n3: عندما يقارب اللحم من الطراوة، رشّ الكسكسي بماء واخبزه فوق القدر لمدة 5–7 دقائق.
steps.n4: اكشف ورشّ بماء بارد قليل وفتّت أي كتل بشوكة.
steps.n5: أزل بذور التمر وقطّعه بشكل تقريبي، امزجه مع الكسكسي وأعيده للخبز حتى يصبح اللحم والكسكسي مطبوخين تماماً. أبقِ عليهما منفصلين.
steps.n6: صب ملعقة من مرق اللحم على الثوم والحريسة والفلفل الحار واغلِها بقوة حتى تقلّ بمقدار النصف.
steps.n7: قدّم الكسكسي واللحم والصلصة بشكل منفصل.

en.title: Tunisian Couscous with Mutton and Dates (Couscous bi Tamr)
en.intro: Recipe 136, page 64 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

steps.n1: Cut the meat into bite-sized cubes. Peel and dice the carrots and turnips.
steps.n2: Boil the meat and vegetables in salted water.
steps.n3: When the meat is nearly done, sprinkle the couscous with water and steam it over the pot for 5–7 minutes.
steps.n4: Uncover, sprinkle lightly with water and break up any lumps with a fork.
steps.n5: Stone and roughly chop the dates, mix them into the couscous and return it to steam over the meat until both are fully cooked. Keep them separate.
steps.n6: Pour a ladle of the meat broth over the garlic, harissa and chili and boil hard until reduced by half.
steps.n7: Serve the couscous, the meat and the sauce separately.

legacySteps: Cut the meat into bite-sized cubes. Peel and dice the carrots and turnips.
Boil the meat and vegetables in salted water.
When the meat is nearly done, sprinkle the couscous with water and steam it over the pot for 5–7 minutes.
Uncover, sprinkle lightly with water and break up any lumps with a fork.
Stone and roughly chop the dates, mix them into the couscous and return it to steam over the meat until both are fully cooked. Keep them separate.
Pour a ladle of the meat broth over the garlic, harissa and chili and boil hard until reduced by half.
Serve the couscous, the meat and the sauce separately.
